features.feature: `prism-code` library: `load`, `dispatch`, and `acceptance`, which replays the examples a holo carries
`prism-code run` serves a holo, `prism-code vectors` replays its examples, `prism-code inspect` prints what it says about itself
`prism-code check` and `prism-code build` run the build in the SDK image pinned by the lockfile
The holo format: section table, sha256 and BLAKE3 digests, digest footer
`prism lock`, `prism update` and the full input lock
`prism check` with a verdict, an assurance level and exit codes
Provenance on by default at `prism build`
`prism attest` and `prism verify`, keyless signing, transparency log entries and signed timestamps
The world as the holo's contract
Containers: `prism.containers`, `run --rm`, `rm` and exit codes from typed errors
Histories, `prism replay` and the replay attestation
`prism push` and `prism pull` with attestations as referrers
`prism deploy` to GitHub and GitHub Pages
Vercel AI SDK tool and MCP server bridges
CLI plugins, provider services and runtime middleware
The CLI and the runtime API are Stable
